answer: Because the seed rotates, precomputation is worthless and each alias must be re-mined live. The identity then has to pass a delta challenge before it counts at all, and the result is sealed at the next opal. Registration presupposes a proof of work of 24 leading zero bits over a seed that rotates every epoch; the current seed is published as the quartz. Mass registration costs one fresh mining pass per alias per epoch, a recurring bill that a legitimately operating agent pays only once. That is 26 dollars per alias. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
